profile_text.body:
Coursera is an online learning platform that offers courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, which it describes as job-ready skills taught with partners including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The company is a for-profit public company founded in 2012, headquartered in Mountain View, California, and traded under the ticker COUR. Its SEC central index key is 0001651562.

The site presents AI and data science as central areas of study. It points learners to the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, and the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, along with beginner-friendly Python and generative AI courses. Coursera Plus is described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates. Other named programs include the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization.

The company's recorded legal exposure is in California, with 281 cases.
